description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the PersonAddressValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic related to person address data.

classes.name: PersonAddressValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the PersonAddressValidator class, verifying validation logic for PersonAddress objects.

methods.name: runBeforeAllTests
methods.description: Initializes test dependencies such as the validator instance and the PersonService before each test method.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheStartDateIsInTheFuture
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the start date of PersonAddress is set to a future date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheEndDateIsBeforeTheStartDate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the end date is earlier than the start date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfAllTheDatesAreValid
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when start and end dates are valid and equal.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfStartDateAndEndDateAreBothNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when both start and end dates are null.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfStartDateIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when start date is null and end date is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfEndDateIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when end date is null and start date is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfRequiredFieldsAreEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that validation fails if required address fields are empty.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassIfRequiredFieldsAreNotEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when required address fields are populated.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks validation success when all text fields are within allowed length limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks validation failure when text fields exceed maximum length constraints.
